main_body: Round leafy tree canopy (about 28 rows tall) on a thin brown trunk with a dark grass/shadow patch at the base
top_band: none as a flat surface: the canopy is a rounded organic mass, with light greens (L 135-170) on the upper right and lower right and dark greens on the left, and no flat horizontal top surface
evidence: The subject is an organic tree, so the top-band/front-face contract for built objects does not apply. The canopy is a volumetric rounded blob lit from the upper right, with a shaded underside above the trunk, and the trunk and base shadow read as a standing object. It is not a flat elevation, a side profile or a top-down plan, and no receding side face is drawn. It reads like the Beodeul tree references.

style.evidence: The canopy has about 6 green steps (L 25, 60, 81, 106, 135, 170) and a dark green-tinted outline (#0e1f1a, 0% neutral edge pixels). It has no large flat fills. However, the whole piece uses only 11 distinct colours and a median of 7 per tile, against about 108 per tile and 427-567 colours in the references. The leaf clumps are blocky, with no per-leaf highlights and no bark texture on the trunk, which is a flat 3px column. Next to the references it looks much thinner and simpler.
